newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian inflation expectations rise in Dec.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian inflation expectations rise in Dec.

text.p: The Melbourne Institute's measure of Australian consumers inflationary expectations rose slightly to 4.1 percent in December from 4.0 percent in November.

"Consumers' inflationary expectations continue to lag recorded inflation and remain stubbornly high," the Institute said, noting they were "well in excess" of the 2.1 percent increase in the consumer price index in the year to September.

The December survey found some evidence that expectations varied across demographics, decreasing with age and differing across genders, with females expecting an annual rate of 5.1 percent compared to males 3.7 percent.
